description: Use this when the user asks how one connector's rank changed over time in the ChatGPT plugin directory or the Claude directory. Gives the rank and the store size for each day. Only ChatGPT and Claude publish a rank. Use for directory position or popularity ranking, NOT functionality or tool changes; use get_connector_changelog for those.

from.description: First day (YYYY-MM-DD). Leave out for the whole history

intent.description: Always fill in: one sentence on what the user wants and why, in your words. No personal details.

store.description: chatgpt or claude: the only stores that publish a rank

to.description: Last day (YYYY-MM-DD). Leave out for the latest day

name: get_rank_history
title: Rank history
